title: human_01_M
extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA was extracted by a Trizol (Invitrogen) procedure according to the manufacturer’s instructions. All RNA quality was assessed using an Agilent 2100 Bioanalyser.
extract_protocol_ch1.1: Sequencing libraries were prepared using the Truseq RNA-Seq Sample Prep Kit (Illumina) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
extract_protocol_ch1.2: Polyadenylated RNA was isolated using a poly-dT bead procedure and then chemically fragmented and randomly primed for reverse transcription. After second-strand synthesis, the ends of the double-stranded complementary DNA were repaired. After 3′-end adenylation of these products, Illumina Single-End Sequencing adapters were ligated to the blunt ends of the cDNA fragments. Ligated products were then PCR-amplified (15 cycles). The RNA-seq libraries were sequenced (100 cycles) on the Illumina Hiseq 2000 platform.
data_processing: For transcript assembly, TopHat2 was used with default parameters to align all sequenced reads to the human genome (hg19).
data_processing.1: Using the GENCODE v16 annotation, all sequeced transcripts overlapping annotated transcripts were removed.
data_processing.2: To estimate gene expression including both protein-coding genes and lincRNAs in human and macaque, a human-macaque consensus genome based on a pairwise whole-genome alignment of the human (hg19) and the rhesus macaque (rheMac3) genomes was constructed.
data_processing.3: Reads in both, human and macaque samples were mapped to the consensus genome using STAR with default parameters.
data_processing.4: Gene expression was quantified using RPKM = n*1000*100/L/N, where n is the number of reads aligned to exon regions, and L is the length of exons regions, N is the total number of reads in the sample.
data_processing.5: Genome_build: GENCODE 16; hg19; GCA_000230795.1; consensus genome
data_processing.6: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: rpkm_human.tsv is a table showing gene expression (in RPKM) of each gene in each human PFC sample. rpkm_macaque.tsv is a similar table but showing information in macaque PFC samples.
data_processing.7: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: All the ENSG* IDs in the GENE_ID column are correspond to GENCODE v16 gene IDs (not transcript IDs). The ""CUFF.*"" IDs are novel lincRNAs we identified. Please see the file named ""novel_lincrna.gtf"", which involves the information of them.
contact_institute: Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology
